spans.s:
रुंट् {c1c} P. (रुंटति) To rob, steal;
cf. लुंट्.

रुंठ् {c1c} P. (रुंठति)
1 To go.
--2 To
steal.
--3 To be lame.
--4 To be idle.
--5 To oppose, resist.

रुंड a. Maimed, mutilated.
--डः,
--डं A headless body, trunk;
वेल्लद्भैरवरुंडमुंडनिकरैर्वीरोऽपिधत्ते भुवः

1 A field of battle.
--2 A
female messenger or go-between.
--3
The threshold of a door.
--4
Superhuman power.
